rationale: unit:given.liveness has only the well-formed-state premise and asserts Live state object iff Allocated state object. lean:Unique/Liveness:WellFormed.live_iff_allocated has exactly that statement for arbitrary classes, state, and object. Live and Allocated from its dependency units have the advertised rooted-path and table-membership meanings. There is no assumption that this state was generated by execution, so the theorem covers the graph property the text promises, including both allocated-implies-live and live-implies-allocated directions.
